label: Transfer overview to arrival and Transfer-sign zone
negative_prompt: hard cuts, heavy blur, low quality, distorted text, invented signs, fake QR code, new gate numbers, extra signage, warped illustration, jitter
prompt: Create a smooth 5 second continuous camera glide from the full Hong Kong airport transfer-route overview into the arrival corridor and 'Transfer / Departures' wayfinding frame. The motion should feel like sliding across one infinite airport route map, not a crossfade. Follow the dotted transfer route from the inbound gate down the corridor to the green Transfer signage cluster, staying entirely airside (no immigration hall, no baggage reclaim). Calm, reassuring, certainty-first pacing for an international-to-international transit guide. clean HKIA-style isometric airport route map, mobile 9:16, white and pale-blue architecture, dark blue dotted passenger route, numbered route markers, premium travel assistant look. Do not invent flight times, fixed gate numbers, retail brands, airline logos, extra signs, or dense text. End exactly on the destination frame composition.
